identity_evidence.scope: North American original XV50 XLE sedan photographed in Canada; cross-check actual US-market Drom 2011–2014 face/body. Photographed country not relabeled as USA, no VIN or engine assertion. Do not cover Russia/Japan ordinary front.
identity_evidence.market_correspondence: Original North-American 2012 XV50 XLE exterior, photographed in Ontario, Canada. Actual US Drom 08.2011–04.2014 reference shows the same regular Toyota badge, V-shaped upper chrome grille, rectangular main lamps with outer amber marker, lower horizontal intake and triangular chrome fog-lamp pocket; four-door sedan/window/body structure also matches. No Hybrid blue emblem/Hybrid fender badge, no SE/Sport bodykit, and no visible different-market version feature. This source is for the explicitly frozen US Market Sedan only, not the separately frozen Russia/Japan faces. Photo location remains Canada. The black hood bug deflector is an actual source accessory, not evidence of different factory market/version.
identity_evidence.actual_visual_observation: 完整黑色四门三厢原款XV50 XLE，前方1/3视角，前格栅、两个主灯、橙角marker、三角镀铬雾灯口和一侧两扇门/侧后窗/尾箱均清楚；银多辐轮/轮胎/镜及首尾轮廓完整但边距很小。真实黑机盖虫挡保留，不能误当格栅或机盖造型；平整顶面此视角未见独立长杆，不凭背景气管/灌木新增顶件。拍摄非美国不改写，外观适用依据是实际US目录零件逐项对应。
identity_evidence.cross_market_gate_evaluation: No visible different factory version feature found relative to the named US-market exterior reference; source accessory and paint color do not constitute Hybrid/Sport market substitution. Sent to identity A for independent spot check; any later contradiction must hold before formal acceptance.
